title: Transcription: the template strand is copied into mRNA
caption: RNA polymerase reads the template strand, adding RNA nucleotides complementary to it, with uracil in place of thymine. The mRNA therefore has the same sequence as the coding strand, with U for T.
alt: A short gene shown as its coding strand, its complementary template strand and the mRNA made from the template, with bases coloured by type.
description: Template strand: TACTTTAAACCGACT, read by RNA polymerase.
mRNA: AUGAAAUUUGGCUGA: the coding strand with U in place of T.
The mRNA is built 5′ to 3′ as the polymerase moves along the template.
